purpose: Lightweight editorial map for the autonomous Confluence of Minds news-to-content loop. This file guides discovery but is not a substitute for checking the current repository before publishing.
global_rules: Before every publication cycle, inspect the current homepage, script.js and native-media-v4.js for live destinations and assets. Never invent a URL or assume a card is still live.
For news-driven content, prioritize events from the previous 7 days and verify factual claims with reliable sources; prefer primary sources when available.
Do not force a connection between news and a CoM world. If no news signal is strong, publish one useful evergreen reuse from the archive instead.
Create a new Confluence article only when the angle is durable enough to remain useful beyond the news cycle. Otherwise use a social post linked to an existing world or Confluence.
Use only CoM-owned media, media already hosted by the CoM site/R2, or newly generated original media. Do not copy third-party copyrighted images for Instagram.
Tone: curious, intelligent, non-boastful, concise, culturally respectful. CoM is a personal constellation of interests, not a claim of expertise in every field.
Avoid duplicate angles and repetitive promotion. Prefer a fresh question, connection, fact or framing.
If a topic is high-risk, factually uncertain, primarily partisan/political, defamatory, or would require unsupported claims, skip it and choose another topic.
Every weekly cycle must publish at least one Instagram item. A new website article is optional and should be quality-gated.
